description: List a TV show's cast and key crew across its whole run, by TMDB id: up to 20 cast members ranked by how many episodes they appear in (each with their main character and episode_count), plus up to 5 people per key crew job — Director, Writer, Teleplay, Story, Executive Producer, Producer, Original Music Composer, Director of Photography — ranked by episode_count, so 'who directed most of it' is the first Director listed. Creators aren't listed here; use get_tv's `created_by`. For one specific episode's director/writer, use get_tv_episode. Get the id from search_tv.
name: get_tv_credits

episode_count.description: Episodes across the whole run this person appears in, in any role.
Episodes across the whole run this person is credited on in this job.

title: Get TV cast & crew
